players.product: Neocloud GPU compute platform: sovereign AI factories in Australia and New Zealand running NVIDIA B300 / GB300 clusters (GPU-as-a-service, AI platform layers, high-performance storage); NVIDIA Cloud Partner

quarterly_data.signal: SharonAI 8-K: collaboration with VAST Data under which SharonAI will offer VAST DataEnclave, the new confidential AI capability of the VAST DataEngine, as part of its AI Factory platform across Australia and Asia-Pacific: a hardware-isolated secure runtime and cryptographic attestation service for running leading AI models onshore, in which proprietary models execute inside confidential virtual machines with NVIDIA GPUs operating in Confidential Compute mode; it is designed to let regulated organizations run advanced AI models onshore (including in fully air-gapped environments) and infrastructure operators, including SharonAI, cannot access customer data or model weights while they are being processed. The company expects the collaboration to significantly expand the number of leading AI models available to its customers.
